paper_title: A Telescope Search for Decaying Relic Axions
coupling_convention: dimensionless xi (two-photon coupling parameter, xi = (4/3)(E/N - 1.92)); NOT converted to g_agamma in GeV^-1
notes: Telescope search for two-photon decay of relic thermal axions in galaxy clusters Abell 2667/2390 using VIMOS IFU at VLT. Constrains the axion two-photon coupling, reported as the dimensionless model parameter xi (Eq. 3, lifetime tau = 6.8e24 xi^-2 m_a^-5 s) rather than g_agamma in GeV^-1. Values from Table I (direct flux-derived 95% CL limits, most conservative density profile) in the mass window 4.5-7.7 eV. I emitted raw xi values; downstream conversion to g_agamma would require the axion mass-f_a relation. This is an astrophysical/cosmological bound (thermal relic axions), so no local DM halo density is assumed.
